reviewed_by: Codex; direct image inspection, not user sign-off
scope: Six deepest-clearance detail sheets reviewed; 36 full loop/loadout sheets exist but have not received visual acceptance

human.notes: Actual shared anchor matrices include the correct body lift, but generic AABB centering at bone pivots places the helmet near the neck and armor volumes around joints. Main/offhand items are partly hidden inside/behind arms in these sampled views. Correct numeric anchors do not approve visual fit. Creature body pixels/geometry remain unchanged.
